title: Padres minors: First-rounder Coleman Borthwick makes first start as Storm clinch Cal League title
text:
Jason Adam rocked in rehab assignment with Triple-A El Paso, Clay Edmondson named to Midwest League All-Star team
SAN DIEGO, CALIFORNIA – SEPTEMBER 5: First and Second Round Draft Picks Coleman Borthwick and Elliot Lascelles spend time on the field before the game against the New York Yankees at Petco Park on September 5, 2026 in San Diego, California.
The Storm also won titles in 2022, 2011, 2001 and 1996. Their most recent championship before this year occurred after the Juan Soto trade removed James Wood from that Jackson Merrill-led team. Two titles from the lower levels this year, however, show there is talent on the come. The Padres’ Gold affiliate in the rookie-level Dominican Summer League became the first team to win back-to-back titles since the 2013-2014 Rangers affiliate.

Lott led Storm hitters with a 1.468 OPS as he had two doubles, two triples, a homer and five RBIs in five postseason games. Two other Storm hitters had an OPS over 1.100 in five playoff games: Contrades and Conover . Borthwick struck out two and walked two in his first start as a pro. After a promotion from high Single-A Fort Wayne, Edmondson had a 10.80 ERA in 18⅓ innings at Double-A San Antonio. Edmondson was a 14th-round pick out of UNC Ashville in 2025.
